description_html: Greg talks about atheist Alex O’Connor’s use of suffering as an argument against God, then he answers a caller’s question about how God could create people with autism—something that adds such difficulties to a person’s life and makes it harder for people to connect with God.

title: Why an Emotivist Can’t Use Suffering to Argue Against the Existence of God
